title: 质量评估固定验证 Seeds

standard.summary: 质量评估生成样本时使用的固定随机种子列表（逗号分隔）。相同 prompt/seed 组合会同时用于基础模型与当前 LoRA，产生严格可比的成对样本。
standard.effect: 填写后评估采样不再随机，每次评估的生成条件完全一致；留空时回落为 sample_seed（或 42）作为基准种子。字符串输入会被解析为整数列表，非法项跳过。
standard.whenToUse: 需要跨 checkpoint 追踪质量变化趋势时必填——随机种子下的分数波动会淹没真实差异；配合 compare_base 做「底模 vs LoRA」增量对比时。
standard.avoidWhen: quality_evaluation_enabled 关闭时无效；只看单次大致水平、不做对比时可以不填。

standard_en.summary: The list of fixed random seeds used when quality evaluation generates samples (comma-separated). The same prompt/seed combination is used for both the base model and the current LoRA, giving strictly comparable paired samples.
standard_en.effect: Once filled in, evaluation sampling is no longer random and every evaluation's generation conditions are identical; left blank it falls back to sample_seed (or 42) as the base seed. A string input is parsed into a list of integers, and invalid items are skipped.
standard_en.whenToUse: Mandatory when you need to track a quality trend across checkpoints -- score fluctuation under random seeds drowns out the real difference; and alongside compare_base for a base-model-against-LoRA comparison.
standard_en.avoidWhen: No effect while quality_evaluation_enabled is off; you can leave it empty when you only want a rough one-off reading and are not comparing.

advanced.principle: 生成式评估的方差主要来自采样随机性；固定 seeds 把评估变成确定性函数，分数差异才能归因于权重变化。种子数 × prompt 数 = 评估样本量，受 quality_evaluation_num_samples 上限截断。
advanced.intervention: configs_validators.py：从配置块或扁平字符串解析整数列表（两种来源都支持）；quality/validation_suite.py：seeds = quality_evaluation_validation_seeds or [sample_seed or 42]，进入验证用例矩阵。
advanced.expectedImpact: 评估可重复性从「±几个点的随机波动」提升到确定性；评估耗时随种子数线性增长。
advanced.tradeoffs: 种子太少（1~2 个）评估对该种子的特异性敏感；建议 3~5 个平衡成本与代表性。
advanced.codePath: quality/validation_suite.py：seeds 解析与用例组装；configs_validators.py：字符串→整数列表归一化

advanced_en.principle: Generative evaluation variance comes mainly from sampling randomness; fixed seeds turn evaluation into a deterministic function so score differences can be attributed to weight changes. Seed count × prompt count = evaluation sample size, capped by quality_evaluation_num_samples.
advanced_en.intervention: configs_validators.py: parses an integer list from either a config block or a flat string; quality/validation_suite.py: seeds = quality_evaluation_validation_seeds or [sample_seed or 42], entering the validation case matrix.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Evaluation repeatability goes from "±a few points of random fluctuation" to deterministic; evaluation time grows linearly with seed count.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Too few seeds (1~2) makes the evaluation sensitive to that seed's idiosyncrasies; 3~5 is recommended to balance cost and representativeness.
advanced_en.codePath: quality/validation_suite.py: seeds parsing and case assembly; configs_validators.py: string → integer list normalization
